mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.user_id AS userId, u.username AS authorName, p.title AS title, p.topic AS topic, p.content AS content, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, (cl.like_id IS NOT NULL) AS liked FROM community_post p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN goods g ON p.goods_id = g.goods_id LEFT JOIN community_like cl ON cl.post_id = p.post_id AND cl.user_id = #{currentUserId} WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.user_id AS userId, u.username AS authorName, p.title AS title, p.topic AS topic, p.content AS content, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, (cl.like_id IS NOT NULL) AS liked FROM community_post p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN goods g ON p.goods_id = g.goods_id LEFT JOIN community_like cl ON cl.post_id = p.post_id AND cl.user_id = #{currentUserId} WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.post_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_post ( user_id, title, topic, content, image_url, goods_id, like_count, comment_count, view_count ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{topic}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{goodsId}, 0, 0, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post SET title = #{title}, topic = #{topic}, content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, goods_id = #{goodsId} WHERE post_id = #{postId}
